Root Cause: Owner factor authority allowed database flag mfaEnabled to satisfy MFA requirement even if Supabase had 0 verified factors
Remediation Applied: Enforced that for designated owner only verified factors from Supabase Auth are authoritative (Postgres flag ignored)

Root Cause: Step-up assurance signing secret fell back to Cashfree or Supabase keys and generated per-invocation secrets in serverless environments
Remediation Applied: Isolated ADMIN_ASSURANCE_SIGNING_KEY requiring >=32 chars in production and stable deterministic key in dev/preview

Root Cause: Offline network drops and DNS timeouts during wallet create-order were displayed as generic 'Gateway unavailable' error
Remediation Applied: Differentiated TypeError (offline/DNS) from HTTP 401/403/503/5xx errors with explicit user messaging

Root Cause: Owner authentication challenge failure fell through to legacy password+totp endpoint verifying against Postgres secret
Remediation Applied: Stopped fallthrough for owner and added server-side guard returning HTTP 403 OWNER_NATIVE_MFA_REQUIRED

Root Cause: Payment redirect target opened blank popups on iOS / mobile web browsers instead of smooth redirect
Remediation Applied: Aligned redirectTarget to '_self' across wallet recharges subscriptions and reports with hosted fallback

Root Cause: Admin sessions lacked sliding window expiration renewal causing sudden logouts during active administration
Remediation Applied: Added POST /api/auth/admin-refresh renewing expiration while respecting absolute session cap

Root Cause: CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_PATHS declaration was defined after CORS middleware causing pre-flight interference on webhooks
Remediation Applied: Hoisted webhook path configuration before CORS middleware registration

Root Cause: Tabular data grids in Customer and Payments modules caused horizontal overflow on viewports < 400px
Remediation Applied: Added responsive card view layout and horizontal scroll containers for data tables
